overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2X Long PURR ETF (PUR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund seeks to deliver 2x leveraged exposure to the daily share price movement of Hyperliquid Strategies Inc. (Nasdaq: PURR), less fees and expenses, through derivatives like swap agreements. PUR was launched on Jul 7, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
